usageNotes: Call this before initiating a cluster join workflow to confirm the target node supports the join API version your client expects. Requires Sys.Audit on / — available to API tokens. Currently always returns 1; check for values greater than your minimum supported version before proceeding.

examples.summary: Check the cluster join API version before adding a new node

tips: No parameters required — the endpoint is a simple capability probe.
Use this as a pre-flight check in node-join automation to guard against version mismatches.
The returned integer is the API version, not the Proxmox VE release version.
